# Release history

The version badge in the nav links here. It bumps on every push to `dev`, and CI refuses a release whose `version.txt` and commit subject disagree.

The games have their own release histories, in their vaults and independent of this site's: `version.html` inside `pg87npy3` (*What Can It Do?*, 42 releases at v1.0.0) and inside `4evnlwrj` (the games vault, at v0.26.0), as of 9 September 2026. This table tracks the site that describes them.
